migrationNotes: First HHH release. Archive Orientation is the first operational Hunger, Harvest, & History package and the production-architecture smoke test the approved Blueprint requires before Core Case 01.

Frozen game-source baseline: 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056. Every dossier quotation is reproduced from the orientation level at that commit, and each quoted source is one of the four the Phase 1 audit records as required. The game repository has since advanced; this release remains pinned to the audited baseline.
Runtime case identity: L0, Temporal Agricultural Archive Facility, TAA Orientation, 2387. instructionalType ORIENTATION; not a numbered Core Case.

Owner-approved printable content baseline: 05f2b5353b8779d9c5769172d94cd10e9049180f. The owner reviewed and physically printed that byte set. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp. Rendered Student, Teacher, Answer Key and Accessible output is unchanged, so the owner's print approval carries forward without a repeat print.

Six tasks teach archive, record, source status, provenance, corroboration and accession, and separate a claim an archive has preserved from a claim history has verified. The culminating product is a short archive-procedure and source-status explanation; the exit transfers it to a record the unit never supplied.

Canonical CER is deliberately not used. The Blueprint fixes this unit's product as a procedure rather than a historical diagnosis, and there is no competing interpretation for a Claim-Evidence-Reasoning frame to adjudicate. Teacher page 4 states the rationale for classroom readers.

The compact orientation dossier is Student page 2 and Accessible page 3 under explicit Fictional Context labelling, so the packet is independently teachable and assessable with no device in the room and no fifth role.

Fiction boundary: TAA, the Concord, the Zhel’ii and resonance threading are all named as invented. The Concord does not appear in the orientation and belongs to the wider story; the Zhel’ii do appear, because Zel'keth is Zhel’ii and Zel'keth's testimony is one of the four orientation sources. Both are marked fictional in Task 4: presence in the level is not the same as reality.

Independent review record: the package was reviewed three times against this baseline. The first review required six corrections and returned CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED, the bounded re-review required one, and the final bounded verification returned INDEPENDENT_REREVIEW_PASS. Owner gate followed.
The unit carries no game-remediation dependency: the Phase 1 audit records finding_ids [] and disposition READY_WITH_BOUNDARY_NOTE for this level.
The release-history schema's caseId pattern was corrected in the immediately preceding commit so an HHH identity can be represented at all; it previously admitted only SSS identities.
